_about: Public-domain Oliver Heywood (1630-1702), ejected Nonconformist minister of Northowram, Yorkshire, for the Word Hoard: The Whole Works of the Rev. Oliver Heywood (5 vols., Idle, 1825-27), with Heart Treasure (1852 edition) and his autobiography and diaries (ed. J. Horsfall Turner, 1881-85). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 94 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
